categories.main_business_segments: Hanyu Group primarily operates in three main business segments: high-efficiency energy-saving household appliance drainage pumps and related components, intelligent water therapy toilets, and new energy vehicle parts. The household appliance segment focuses on drainage pumps, water valves, and related components for washing machines, dishwashers, and dryers. The intelligent water therapy toilet segment integrates smart toilets with colon hydrotherapy technology. The new energy vehicle parts segment includes electronic water pumps and charging piles for electric vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core motor technologies, electromagnetic, fluid mechanics, materials science, and structural design expertise to develop its products. It has proprietary technologies and patents in high-efficiency energy-saving pumps, non-contact water therapy technology for smart toilets, and automotive electronic water pumps. Production is based on advanced automated manufacturing processes, lean production, and strict quality control systems certified by ISO9001 and IATF16949 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanyu Group serves major global household appliance manufacturers such as Whirlpool, Haier, Midea, Samsung, Arcelik, Vestel, and Hisense. Its products are used in washing machines, dishwashers, and other white goods. The intelligent water therapy toilets target hotels, residential developments, maternity centers, health care centers, and airports, promoted through distributors and e-commerce. The new energy vehicle parts are aimed at the growing electric vehicle market, including automotive manufacturers and charging infrastructure providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas operations, including a wholly-owned subsidiary in Thailand. Its products are sold globally, with a substantial portion of revenue from international markets, especially developed countries in Europe and North America, as well as emerging markets. The company maintains a global supply chain and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanyu Group operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of key components such as drainage pumps and electronic water pumps to household appliance and automotive manufacturers. It also engages in downstream activities through direct sales and distribution of finished products like intelligent water therapy toilets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding product lines in household appliance pumps, intelligent toilets with medical functionalities, and new energy vehicle components. It aims to maintain technological leadership through patent development and integration of multidisciplinary expertise. Strategic priorities include automation of production, market expansion, and development of new products aligned with national policies on energy efficiency and new energy vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Hanyu Group generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products to household appliance manufacturers and other industrial clients. It operates mainly on a make-to-order basis with direct sales accounting for the majority of revenue. The company also earns income from licensing its patented technologies and from sales of new energy vehicle parts and intelligent water therapy toilets through distributors and e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in the niche market of household appliance drainage pumps, breaking international monopolies with proprietary technologies. It competes with major global appliance component suppliers and emerging domestic brands in intelligent toilets and new energy vehicle parts. Its strong R&D, quality control, and long-term customer relationships position it favorably against competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hanyu Group achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing a 4.44% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 234 million, slightly declining by 4.04%. The company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.46 billion with steady growth in net assets. R&D expenses accounted for 3.46% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment in innovation. The company’s cash flow from operations decreased by 27.04%, influenced by increased receivables and inventory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanyu Group differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies in energy-efficient pumps and smart water therapy toilets with medical certifications (China and FDA). It offers high-quality, reliable products with strong cost advantages due to automated production and supply chain management. The company’s integration of smart toilet and colon hydrotherapy technology provides unique health benefits, while its close collaboration with leading appliance manufacturers ensures tailored solutions and market responsiveness.
